name: Bollinger band explainer
summary: Explain middle SMA ± k·stddev bands and compute them from a pasted close list.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. Default period 20 and k = 2. Bands describe dispersion of your sample, not a volatility product FRIDAY can trade.
